integration_rules: Venue membership is independent of the current VOSE-only session filter; do not hide a cinema because it has no matching session today.
Keep original audio, Spanish subtitles, Catalan subtitles, English subtitles, dubbed and unknown distinct; preserve source labels and filter each session variant.
Use venue + provider + session identity; preserve Aribau room-to-entrance mapping and resolve Verdi room-to-site mapping.
Do not interpret future film announcements as scheduled sessions or source status flags as seat availability.
Keep current sessions separate from archive pages, past festivals and historical programme cycles.
Do not promote programme endpoints to live support until normalized sessions, identity, timezone, deduplication, links and source failure handling are verified.
Seasonal events, museums, festivals and civic programmes need their own category, location and admission mode; never count an organiser as a new cinema.
